intro.text: A temple hidden in high mountains, built by the Sovereign's elite priests, who were told to guard the Bands of Mourning there until he came back.
A bleak, one-storey fortress of fieldstone close to the Seran Range's tallest peaks, southeast of Dulsing, built by the Sovereign's priests to guard the Bands of Mourning until his return.

description.text: At the entrance stands a big statue of the Sovereign gripping a wooden spear. Inside, a long hall lit by an ettmetal-powered device is crowded with traps: spikes, spiked logs, spike-lined pits, poison darts and acid. Past them, a door ringed with strange symbols opens when three of them, in a script only the Sovereign knows, are pressed.

items.text: Some of the priests returned south and spread word of the temple, and many Southern Scadrians took it as the Sovereign's challenge to find the Bands. A band of Hunters set out to destroy it, but some mutinied to take the Bands for themselves; after its traps killed many of their men they turned back, and they were executed on reaching home.
